description: This file defines the RestJsonParser class, which implements REST-JSON parsing logic for AWS SDK services that communicate via JSON payloads, such as Glacier and Elastic Transcoder.

classes.name: RestJsonParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling REST-JSON responses in AWS SDK, extending AbstractRestParser and utilizing PayloadParserTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with the AWS service description and an optional JSON parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the JSON payload from the HTTP response and merges it into the result structure.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload from a stream and returns the parsed structure for a given member.
